subject: Request: Technical on-call window for private deploy preflight
messages:
From: Sam Jensen <s.jensen@medallionhealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops+infra@medallionhealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Technical on-call window for private deploy preflight

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the earlier trial environment — our infra team dug in and we need a focused, 90- to 120-minute technical on-call / deep-dive with your architecture and ops folks to walk our network and air-gap constraints. We are prepping an on-prem, VPC-first deployment with strict egress controls; this session is specifically to:

- validate network adjacency and firewall rules (no outbound to internet)
- confirm the KMS/HSM handoff and secrets flow
- review the proposed KV cache persistence and KV-store network endpoints
- run through the installation checklist for the air-gapped bootstrap (image signing, transport medium)

Can your team run this session the week of Feb 24? We prefer afternoon windows (PST) — our tentative slots: Feb 24 13:00–15:00, Feb 25 14:00–16:00, or Feb 25 16:00–17:30 if you need a shorter window.

Attendees from our side will include Ops (ops+infra@medallionhealth.com) and myself. Please include the person who owns network/topology, the install lead, and whoever will own post-deploy monitoring. Also let us know what prework you need — we can attach network diagrams and procurement constraints.

I attached a first-pass network spec and the procurement timeline.

Attachments: medallion_network_spec_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)

Thanks,
Sam Jensen
Director, Infrastructure
Medallion Health

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jensen <s.jensen@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Technical on-call window for private deploy preflight

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely run this deep-dive. Proposing the following concrete options (all times PST):

- Option A: Feb 25, 10:00–12:00 (2h) — full architecture + runbook walkthrough
- Option B: Feb 24, 13:00–14:30 (1.5h) — focused network + bootstrap path
- Option C: Feb 25, 16:00–17:00 (1h) — high-level with follow-ups scheduled

I've looped in Marissa (deploy lead), Grace (security/compliance), and Priyom (runtime/ops) so they can cover the KMS/HSM and KV/cache pieces. Marissa, can you prep the preliminary agenda and call invite? Grace — we'll need a 20-min slot inside the meeting for compliance and evidence requirements.

Prework request for your team: latest network diagram (layered), outbound egress policy doc, and any procurement blackout dates. We'll circulate a short agenda and a runbook snapshot ahead of the call.

Proposed calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite-token-1
Preflight checklist (read-only): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/Private+Deploy+Preflight+Checklist

Attached is a first-draft agenda and an internal network diagram for reference. If none of those slots work, tell us the blackout windows and we'll re-propose.

Attachments: rw_private_deploy_agenda_v1.pdf (pdf, 45KB); network-diagram-v2.pdf (pdf, 780KB)

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: Sam Jensen <s.jensen@medallionhealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops+infra@medallionhealth.com
Date: Wed, 22 Feb 2028 15:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Technical on-call window for private deploy preflight

Thanks, Sean — appreciate the quick turnaround. We have a procurement freeze that just landed for Feb 25 (vendor onboarding hold) and can't take any vendor-facing deep divess that day. Can we shift to any of these windows instead (PST):

- Feb 26, 09:00–11:00
- Feb 26, 13:00–15:00
- Feb 27, 10:00–12:00

Also please ensure Grace or your compliance lead can cover SOC/SaaS boundary questions and that someone can walk the HSM key-rotation flow (we'll want to capture that in our audit). I've attached the procurement hold memo for visibility.

> On Tue, Feb 21, 2028 at 10:05 AM, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Proposing the following concrete options (all times PST):
> > - Option A: Feb 25, 10:00–12:00 (2h) — full architecture + runbook walkthrough
> > - Option B: Feb 24, 13:00–14:30 (1.5h) — focused network + bootstrap path
> > - Option C: Feb 25, 16:00–17:00 (1h) — high-level with follow-ups scheduled
>
Attachments: procurement_hold_notice.pdf (pdf, 90KB)

Sam Jensen
Director, Infrastructure
Medallion Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jensen <s.jensen@medallionhealth.com>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Feb 2028 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Technical on-call window for private deploy preflight

Hi Sam — noted, and thanks for the heads up on procurement. We've rescheduled the invite for Feb 26, 13:00–15:00 PST to give the team a full 2-hour block (calendar link updated). Agenda will include:

1) 15m — Introductions & desired outcomes
2) 40m — Network topology and firewall rule review (Sam’s team + our network lead)
3) 25m — KMS/HSM key flow and rotation demo (Grace + Priyom)
4) 20m — Air-gap bootstrap process and image verification
5) 20m — Post-deploy monitoring and runbook handoff / next steps

Action items before the call:
- Sam: share the final network diagram and the procurement blackout memo (we have your attachment).
- Priyom: prepare the KV-cache persistence notes and a short slide on persistence endpoints.
- Grace: prepare evidence matrix items for SOC scope.
- Sean: I'll draft the invite and include the Confluence checklist.

I've attached the updated agenda (rw_private_deploy_agenda_v1.pdf). If you need us to compress to 90-min, say the word and we'll prioritize items.

Thanks — marissa
Marissa Cole
Deploys Lead | Redwood Inference
